claims.claim_text: Auditor PwC has concluded substantial doubt exists about Lilium's ability to continue as a going concern; accumulated losses of EUR 1,359.3 million as of Dec 31, 2023; cash of EUR 83.5 million plus EUR 111.6 million current other financial assets; expects continued operating losses and substantial financing needs for the foreseeable future; explicitly states it must raise additional capital in next 12 months or curtail/discontinue operations.
claims.subject: Lilium N.V.
claims.object_value: PCAOB-acknowledged substantial doubt; EUR 195M total liquidity vs EUR 232M FY2023 operating cash burn
claims.source_quote: we have concluded that there is substantial doubt about our ability to continue as a going concern... If we are unsuccessful in raising the sufficient capital, we will be required to undertake... additional significant cost-cutting measures, including significant headcount reductions that could mean that we would be forced to curtail or discontinue our operations.

claims.claim_text: Azul (NYSE: AZUL) has executed a term sheet to commit to purchase 220 Lilium Jets for an aggregate value of up to $1.0 billion, subject to completion of aircraft certification activities. Term sheet originally signed July 2021; extended in January 2023 and again December 2023 because definitive agreements were not finalized. David Neeleman, Azul's founder and controlling shareholder, sits on Lilium's board.
claims.subject: Azul Linhas Aereas Brasileiras
claims.object_value: 220 Lilium Jets, up to $1.0 billion, term-sheet stage only (not definitive); twice extended due to non-finalization
claims.source_quote: On July 31, 2021, we executed a term sheet in which we agreed to enter into negotiations with Azul to establish a strategic collaboration whereby Azul is expected to commit to purchase from Lilium 220 Lilium Jets for an aggregate value of up to $1.0 billion, subject to completion of aircraft certification activities... In January 2023, Azul and Lilium agreed to extend the period in which the definitive agreements are to be finalized by one year and in December 2023 agreed to further extend the period by an additional six months.

claims.claim_text: Lilium has a non-cancelable cloud-subscription purchase obligation with a shareholder providing 'advanced data analytics capability' for $50,000 thousand over five years; in 2023 issued 9.67M Class A shares to settle EUR 9.4M of the contract balance; remaining commitment EUR 18.8M as of Dec 31, 2023. Earlier, in Dec 2022, issued 3.1M Class A shares to settle a $4.5M payable to the same vendor.
claims.subject: Lilium N.V.
claims.object_value: Shareholder vendor (data-analytics): $50M five-year commitment; multiple share-for-payable settlements totaling 12.77M Class A shares in 2023 against ~EUR 13.9M in payables
claims.source_quote: In 2021, the Group entered into a non-cancelable purchase obligation for a cloud subscription with a shareholder (which provides advanced data analytics capability), including support services, updates and related professional services, for 42,433 thousand ($ 50,000 thousand) payable in incremental annual installments over five years... During the year, the Group issued 9,672,897 Class A shares to settle a total amount of 9,389 thousand on the contract.

claims.claim_text: Lilium received $175M in pre-funded warrant proceeds from Aceville (Tencent Holdings affiliate) under May 2023 Securities Purchase Agreement; Aceville is wholly owned by TCH Delta Limited, wholly owned by Tencent Holdings Limited; Tencent-affiliated David Wallerstein is a non-executive director.
claims.subject: Aceville Pte Ltd / Tencent Holdings Limited
claims.object_value: $175M pre-funded exercise of warrants for up to 184.2M Class A Shares at $1.00 strike
claims.source_quote: Aceville is a direct wholly-owned subsidiary of TCH Delta Limited, which in turn is a direct wholly-owned subsidiary of Tencent Holdings Limited, an affiliate of our shareholder Tencent. Our non-executive director, David Wallerstein, is an employee of an affiliate of Tencent.

claims.claim_text: Lilium has a strategic battery-technology relationship with Ionblox (US joint venture / associate; battery cell supplier), with a licensing agreement for Ionblox IP, royalty payable on battery capacity manufactured for the Lilium Jet, and a non-cancelable EUR 7.24M development-agreement commitment plus EUR 3.53M committed capex with Ionblox as of Dec 31, 2023.
claims.subject: Ionblox Inc.
claims.object_value: Battery JV / licensee; EUR 7.24M dev-agreement + EUR 3.53M capex commitments; license royalty from 2026
claims.source_quote: In June 2021, the Group closed a licensing agreement for the use of Ionblox's intellectual property, to be paid as a royalty rate on battery capacity manufactured for the Lilium Jet... As of December 31, 2023, the Group has a non-cancelable commitment of 7,240 thousand (2022: 7,702 thousand) on the Development agreement. Further, the Group has committed to capital expenditure of 3,526 thousand (2022: nil) with Ionblox.

claims.claim_text: Lilium describes itself as developing novel proprietary eVTOL technology — the Lilium Jet — including ducted electric jet engines, batteries, and aircraft systems, supported by a substantial intellectual property portfolio.
claims.subject: Lilium GmbH
claims.object_value: eVTOL / electric ducted fan / battery aircraft systems IP
claims.source_quote: In developing its novel eVTOL technology, the Group incurs significant research and development costs. The costs for internally generated research and development are expensed when incurred... The self-developed eVTOL technology used in the development of the Lilium Jet is highly innovative

claims.claim_text: Lilium is building a serial production factory and expects substantial cash burn for completing Type Certification, building its serial-production factory, and launching commercial operations; targeting first manned flight test of the Lilium Jet in late 2024.
claims.subject: Lilium GmbH
claims.object_value: serial-production factory under construction (Germany, Wessling/Oberpfaffenhofen area per group-info location of non-current PP&E)
claims.source_quote: we expect substantial cash burn in connection with our ongoing activities, particularly for completing the Type Certification process, building our serial production factory, launching commercial operations... we will require substantial additional cash to fund our operations until our first manned flight test of the Lilium Jet targeted to occur in late 2024

claims.claim_text: Lilium's distinctive product brand 'Lilium Jet' should appear in U.S.-listed counterparty / supplier / customer / competitor SEC filings as part of an emerging eVTOL ecosystem disclosed by airlines, OEM suppliers, and competitors.
claims.subject: Lilium N.V. / Lilium Jet
claims.object_value: External SEC-filer mentions of 'Lilium Jet' brand
claims.source_quote: Class A Shares and Public Warrants are listed on Nasdaq under the symbols LILM and LILMW... advance the development and certification of our Lilium Jets and the commercialization of our Private and Fractional Sales and Turnkey Enterprise solutions.
